newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan grains/oilseeds tender results - June.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan grains/oilseeds tender results - June.

text.p: Taiwan interests in June bought a total of 254,000 tonnes soybeans, 16,000 tonnes corn and 66,000 tonnes wheat at tenders.
Basic information of May soybean/corn tender results

Note: Prices based on cost-and-freight basis, in US$ per tonne or U.S. cents over Chicago futures. Delivery periods for U.S. soy/corn shipments are stated for the U.S. Gulf of Mexico. Shipments from the Pacific Northwest are 15 days after the Gulf.

Wheat tenders comprised Dark Northern Spring (DNS), Hard Red Winter (HRW), White Wheat (WW) and Soft Wheat (SW). Wheat shipments all are slated for delivery from the Pacific Northwest.
